title: Rooftop fire pit 4 bedroom 4 bath Opryland 5 min
description:
Welcome to Music Manor in the vibrant and beautiful East Nashville. Minutes from downtown and from the airport, this home has everything you need to enjoy Nashville in style. With 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, full kitchen and coffee bar, and a roof top bbq and fire pit, this home will make your trip memorable.

The space
Large bedrooms  each with comfortable beds, their own TV, and attached bathrooms. A photo wall for the perfect shot, board games, and roof top with BBQ and fire pit to enjoy the warm evenings- this home has it all. Stocked with all the essentials from towels to soap, this home is hosted by a friendly owner.

Guest access
Whole house
